title: nan
authors: Liu Y.; Kuang Y.; Liu C.; Zhang X.
key_contribution: Presents a factor graph optimization (FGO) visual SLAM algorithm integrating HD map lane constraints and IMU preintegration to eliminate cumulative positioning errors in GNSS-denied urban areas.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
